title: A Sparse Low-Rank Biclique Decomposition for Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2611.25826v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Low-rank plus sparse decompositions, such as robust PCA, typically model the low-rank component as dense and the sparse component as corruption. This viewpoint is poorly suited to graph adjacency matrices, where sparsity is structural and dense low-rank factors destroy the combinatorial and computational properties of the graph. We propose signed biclique decomposition (SBD), a sparse low-rank decomposition for integer-weighted graphs that represents the structured component as a sum of sparse signed binary rank-one factors, together with a sparse signed residual. The resulting representation remains discrete, interpretable, sparse, and compatible with standard linear algebra. We formulate fixed-rank and greedy SBD objectives and derive a gain-based greedy algorithm with theoretical guarantees. translated_title: 一种面向图的稀疏低秩双团分解方法
translated_abstract: 低秩加稀疏分解（如鲁棒PCA）通常将低秩成分建模为稠密的，而将稀疏成分视为损坏或噪声。这种视角并不适合图的邻接矩阵，因为图中的稀疏性是结构性的，而稠密的低秩因子会破坏图的组合性质和计算性质。我们提出符号双团分解（Signed Biclique Decomposition, SBD），这是一种针对整数加权图的稀疏低秩分解方法，它将结构化成分表示为稀疏符号二值秩一因子之和，再加上一个稀疏符号残差。所得的表示保持离散性、可解释性和稀疏性，并与标准线性代数兼容。我们形式化了固定秩与贪心SBD目标，并推导出一种具有理论保证的基于增益的贪心算法。实验表明，SBD能够在噪声图中恢复块结构，同时其因子化表示支持高效的稀疏矩阵乘法运算。
tldr: 提出符号双团分解（SBD），一种面向整数加权图的稀疏低秩分解方法，能够在保持图的结构稀疏性、离散性和可解释性的同时，有效恢复噪声图中的块结构并支持高效稀疏矩阵运算。
en_tdlr: We propose Signed Biclique Decomposition (SBD), a sparse low-rank decomposition for integer-weighted graphs that preserves structural sparsity, discreteness and interpretability, and recovers block structure in noisy graphs.
